title: 半导体估值便宜：资本开支担忧之外，英伟达领导层变动才是关键？
speaker: Edward Chan

segments.en: I think it would be a difficult thesis to carry on. Would you be looking to add? I mean, you mentioned you're still neutral. I mean, the stock, the market's de-rated the stock quite kind of like, I mean, it's trading in single digits now.
segments.zh: 我认为这个逻辑很难持续。你会考虑加仓吗？你提到仍持中性立场。这只权益资产、市场已经大幅下调估值，现在市盈率只有个位数。

segments.en: So I mean, arguably, they've somewhat discounted the change in fundamental.
segments.zh: 所以可以说，它们已在某种程度上消化了基本面的变化。

segments.en: Would you say this is cheap enough? I think there's two things to this valuation, right?
segments.zh: 你觉得这够便宜了吗？我认为估值要看两点。

segments.en: One is the broader decline in the whole semiconductor industry because of the industry concerned about 2028's CAPEX.
segments.zh: 一是整个半导体行业因担忧2028年资本开支而普遍下跌。

segments.en: And so it's not just NVIDIA. It's everyone else. If you look at the multiples across the supply chain, memories are trading at one, two times PE, right, and then you look across the supply chain, everything is cheap.
segments.zh: 所以不只是英伟达，其他公司也一样。看看供应链各环节的估值倍数，存储芯片市盈率才一两倍，整个供应链都很便宜。

segments.en: So I think that reflects the concern, the market half, about the 2028 CAPEX.
segments.zh: 我认为这反映了市场对2028年资本开支的担忧。

segments.en: So that's one element of that valuation.
And the second element is, of course, the leadership change in NVIDIA, which I think frankly is the only and the most important factor here.
segments.zh: 第二个因素当然是英伟达的领导层变动，坦率说我认为这是这里唯一也是最重要的因素。
